name: madcide
description: Mad-C language support, served by madcide's own compiler over LSP.

madcide.madcPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `madc` binary. Empty means: look for `bin/madc` under the workspace folder, then `madc` on PATH.

madcide.madcidePath.markdownDescription: Path to `madcide.mad`, relative to the workspace folder (or absolute). madc runs this script; `--lsp` makes it a language server.

madcide.serverFile.markdownDescription: The document madcide opens at startup. Empty means: the active `.mad` editor, else the first `.mad` file in the workspace. Every other file the editor opens is added to the same session on demand.

madcide.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the madcide command line.

madcide.trace.server.description: Log the LSP traffic between VS Code and madcide in the madcide output channel.
